meta.title: Kep Crab Market Guide | Seafood Market in Kep Cambodia
meta.description: Discover Kep Crab Market in Kep Province, Cambodia. Opening hours, location, how to get there, and practical travel tips for visitors.

hero.title: Kep Crab Market
hero.subtitle: One of the most representative seafood culture markets in Cambodia's Kep Province, known for locally caught fresh crab, seafood trading, and a seaside dining experience.

about.title: About Kep Crab Market
body: Kep Crab Market (Khmer: ផ្សារក្ដាមក្រុងកែប) is a local seafood market in Krong Kaeb, Kep Province, in southern Cambodia.
The area has a long fishing history, and the market reflects the region's maritime culture, local fishing traditions, and everyday seafood trade.
For visitors, the market offers a way to experience local daily life and observe the trading of crab and other seafood up close, in an objective and non-commercial setting.

highlights.title: Market Highlights
highlights.intro: Explore the experiences this market offers to visitors.

items.title: Seafood Culture
items.desc: The coastal Kep region has long relied on marine resources, and the local market showcases traditional fishing life.

items.title: Crab Trading Experience
items.desc: Visitors can observe local residents buying, preparing, and trading seafood products.

items.title: Seaside Atmosphere
items.desc: Located near the shore, the market lets you feel the everyday life of local residents.

items.title: Photography Experience
items.desc: Great for morning markets, fishing boats, coastal scenery, and documenting local life.

bestTime.title: Best Time to Visit
bestTime.intro: The market opens daily 05:00 – 17:30. Actual activity may vary with weather, festivals, and season.

items.title: Morning (05:00 – 10:00)
items.desc: Seafood is more plentiful, market activity is lively, and the light is good for photography.

items.title: Afternoon (15:00 – 17:30)
items.desc: The temperature is lower and the seaside environment is comfortable.

transport.title: How to Get There
transport.intro: This site provides public information only and does not recommend specific private commercial services. Below are examples of common routes; schedules and prices are subject to local conditions.

routes.title: From the airport to Kep Crab Market
routes.desc: Kep has no nearby airport; the closest major international airport is Phnom Penh International Airport (PNH). Suggested route:
steps: Arrive at Phnom Penh International Airport, complete immigration and collect luggage
Take a taxi or pre-arranged hired car outside the terminal
Travel along the national highway to Kampot, then continue to Kep
In Kep town, walk, take a Tuk Tuk, or ride a motorbike to the crab market

routes.title: From Phnom Penh (bus / public transport)
steps: Go to a long-distance bus station in Phnom Penh
Take a bus bound for Kep (or via Kampot)
After arriving in Kep, transfer to a Tuk Tuk or motorbike to the market
Total about 3–4 hours, depending on the bus schedule

routes.title: From Phnom Penh (private car / hired car)
routes.desc: Flexible, suitable for families or groups:
steps: Depart Phnom Penh via NH2 / NH3 highway heading south
Pass through Kampot, then turn onto the road to Kep
Navigate to Kep Crab Market or nearby parking
Total about 2.5–3.5 hours (depending on traffic and road conditions)

routes.title: From central Kep town
routes.desc: The market is within Kep town and not far:
steps: If staying near the market, simply walk there
Ride a motorbike or e-scooter along the main road
Hail a Tuk Tuk in town and tell the driver you want the crab market
Take a taxi / hired car, suitable for families with luggage

facilities.title: Nearby Public Facilities
facilities.intro: Information to meet visitor needs. This site does not name specific businesses.

items.title: Restrooms (WC)
items.desc: Sanitary facilities may be available at the market and nearby public areas. Visitors should confirm availability in advance.

items.title: Accessibility
items.desc: Traditional market environments may have uneven ground, narrow passages, and peak-hour crowds. Visitors with limited mobility should plan routes ahead and avoid peak times.

items.title: Parking
items.desc: Motorbike parking and small vehicle spaces are usually available nearby. Demand may increase during holidays.

items.title: Dining
items.desc: The area may offer seafood, local specialties, and drinks or snacks. This site does not recommend any specific restaurant.

items.title: Accommodation
items.desc: Kep offers seaside stays, town stays, guesthouses, and resort-style lodging. No hotel ranking is provided.

items.title: Shops
items.desc: Nearby you may find daily-goods stores, food stalls, and travel supplies.

items.title: Fuel & Charging
items.desc: Within Kep town you can usually find traditional fuel stations and basic vehicle services. EV users should confirm charging options in advance.

items.title: Coastal weather
items.desc: The coast brings cooling breezes, but be mindful of strong midday sun.

items.title: Rainy season
items.desc: More rainfall and changing sea conditions. Market activity may occasionally slow down.

items.title: Dry season
items.desc: Good for outdoor activities and coastal photography.

items.title: Respect locals
items.desc: Keep a friendly attitude and respect local culture.

items.title: Confirm prices before buying
items.desc: Agree on the price before purchasing any seafood.

items.title: Watch your belongings
items.desc: Markets get crowded; keep an eye on bags and phones.

items.title: Avoid blocking trade
items.desc: Do not obstruct passages or interfere with market activities.

items.title: Protect the environment
items.desc: Respect nature and keep the coast clean.

items.title: Reduce plastic waste
items.desc: Help cut plastic use by bringing a reusable bag.

items.q: What are the opening hours of Kep Crab Market?
items.a: The market is generally open daily from about 05:00 to 17:30. Activity may vary with weather and season.

items.q: Is entry to the market free?
items.a: Yes, entering the market area is generally free. You only pay for what you buy or eat.
You can reach it on foot, by motorbike, Tuk Tuk, or car from within Kep town, or from Phnom Penh via Kampot.
Yes, the market is an open public space suitable for families and photographers who want to experience local life.
